RANKED-4-ABYSS-REVENANT.description: Small monsters trade to fill the graveyard; the Ambusher, Sylva and Hades keep reviving the army.

RANKED-4-ABYSS-ASSASSIN.zhDescription: 裂箭、汲取與彗星逐一點殺，幽冥巨龍靠死亡回血。
